invariants.rationale: rollbackInstantTime is passed as a String to the executor and expected to be non-null.
commitInstant is either null or an instance of HoodieInstant as per method signature.
deleteInstants is a primitive boolean parameter, so always true or false.
skipLocking is a primitive boolean parameter, so always true or false.
context is a parameter of type HoodieEngineContext and expected to be non-null.
